title: Chapter 786
text:
The next day, the various governments of Blue Star's cities gathered, and the first to accept the Evolution Cube's transformation were the residents of the capital, Black Star City.

The spaceship carried Han Xiao, Bennett, and the rest, and slowly flew above the city. The energy released by the Evolution Cube covered the entire crowd.

"Perhaps this will open a new chapter in the history of the Blue Star Civilization." Bennett could not help but sigh.

He had already undergone the transformation the night before, so he had a deep understanding of the effects of the Evolution Cube. It was as if he had returned to the prime of his life. His body was filled with energy, and his mind was more agile.

Turning around to look at Han Xiao's back, Bennett was filled with emotions. For Blue Star to have its current era, it was all thanks to this old friend of his.

Twenty years ago, who would have thought that a traitor of the Germinal Organization could reach such incredible heights?

The speed of the spaceship was very fast, and the Evolution Cube was soon spread to every city.

Han Xiao did not care about how happy the people were. Naturally, Bennett would take care of the follow-up matters, and he would definitely publicize his contributions. He might even write this story into the textbooks.

Han Xiao completed his work and did not plan to stay in Blue Star any longer. He wanted to leave immediately. Sylvia had sent him news that the Red Empire's team had entered the Garton Star System and was about to arrive at the Black Star Corps headquarters. He had to return.

The spaceship returned to the dock, and a gentle lady was waiting there with Nero.

Bennett brought his officers down from the spaceship and chatted with the lady for a while. He then turned around and pushed Nero's back, indicating for him to get on the spaceship.

"Go, your future is the sea of stars. Black Star will take care of you," Bennett said slowly.

Nero's eyes were red. Last night, he had found out that he was going to follow his godfather into the universe. He had almost thought that his godfather did not want him anymore and had cried. Bennett had persuaded him for a long time before he finally accepted this matter.

He had only read about the galactic society in textbooks and on the internet. This was the first time he had entered the universe. Thinking about the strange aliens in the books, he was both scared and excited.

With his short legs, Nero climbed up the stairs with much difficulty. Han Xiao stood beside the door and pulled him in.

Han Xiao and Bennett looked at each other and nodded.

"Close the door," Han Xiao ordered.

Chi —

As the cabin door slowly closed, Nero turned around and saw Bennett and his mother standing on the dock. They had reluctant expressions on their faces as they waved goodbye to him.

Crack.

The last line of sight disappeared, and the cabin door was tightly locked, as if it was separating two different worlds.

"Come with me."

Han Xiao shook his head and pulled Nero to the cockpit.

Nero looked through the porthole and saw the city rapidly shrinking beneath his feet. The blue sky above his head gradually turned dark.

Dong.

The spaceship shook slightly and left the planet's atmosphere. The Blue Star's full appearance appeared in front of Nero's eyes. He was dumbfounded and looked at this scene in a daze. This experience was too shocking for a child like him.

He grabbed onto Han Xiao's trousers tightly. This was the only support for his young heart.

Han Xiao stood quietly by the side with a smile. After the spaceship entered hyperdrive, he pulled Nero out of the cockpit and introduced him to the various galactic knowledge while showing him around the spaceship.

"… There are many things to take note of. You don't have to be nervous. With me here, most people in the universe will not be able to harm you."

The two of them came to the hall. Ames, Hella, and the rest of the Black Star Guards were chatting. When they saw Nero, they all had amiable expressions and took turns to tease him. Towards this obedient child, everyone was quite fond of him. Even Hila had put away her unapproachable aura, and her sharp eyes seemed to have softened.

"This is Uncle Bennett's child." Aurora hugged Nero in her arms and couldn't bear to let him go. She was the youngest here in terms of age and seniority. Now that there was finally someone younger, she was very happy. Furthermore, this was the child of someone she knew.

Nero's face turned red, and he froze on the spot, not daring to move.

Han Xiao could not help but pull Aurora away and helplessly said, "Stop hugging him. Do you want to suffocate him to death?"

Lowering her head to look at her heavy chest, Aurora's face turned slightly red. She snorted and punched Han Xiao's waist. However, to him, it was no different from scratching an itch.

"Right, Uncle Han Xiao gave you a present. Let me give you a present too." Aurora's eyes suddenly lit up. She grabbed her chest and pulled out a ball of warm golden energy, which she slapped into Nero's chest.

"What … What is this?" Nero was startled. Immediately after, his body felt warm and comfortable, and an inexhaustible strength appeared in his body.

He curiously touched his chest, as though he could not understand how this ball of golden light entered his body.

Aurora blinked her eyes and said with satisfaction, "This is my ability. I gave you a ball of refined life energy that will prevent you from getting sick. Furthermore, it will continuously activate your cells and strengthen your body. In the future, you will grow taller and stronger."

Not only could her life energy heal people, but it could also increase the target's BUFF and even stimulate the growth of living beings.

For example, the giant white bear that had been left behind in the Black Star Army headquarters to eat and drink every day had indirectly absorbed a large amount of life force from Aurora, turning into a powerful individual. In other words, if one absorbed Aurora's life force for a long period of time, there would be a chance for one to turn from a normal template to an elite template and obtain stronger attributes.

Seeing this, Hella, who had been silent all this while, stood up and said, "Then I will give you a present as well."

She rubbed her fingers and shot out a red energy ball, which hit the back of Nero's hand.

"Ah!" The back of Nero's hand felt as though it had been scalded, and he cried out in shock while holding onto the back of his hand with tears in his eyes.

He lowered his head and saw a bright red pattern on the back of his hand that extended all the way to his elbow like a tattoo.

"This is the Undead Brand. As long as you kill a living being, this brand will absorb the remnant soul of the other party and strengthen your spiritual energy," Hella said casually.

Although it was not appropriate to mention killing to a child, everyone was used to it. Almost everyone present was a Calamity Grade Super, and all of them had killed hundreds of thousands of people. They would never deliberately describe a fairytale world to a child. Furthermore, since Nero had been groomed by Black Star, he would definitely not be an ordinary person in the future. Thus, no one avoided this topic.

Nero was a little afraid and carefully pulled his sleeves, wanting to cover the tattoo on the back of his hand.

"Then I will give you something as well." Fu Ding smiled, and his explosive friendliness made Nero relax.

Fu Ding released an invisible psychic energy into Nero's mind, forming a Calamity Grade Psychic barrier to prevent others from prying into his mind or harming him.

The Black Star Guards were not stingy and took out all sorts of things to give to Nero. Although they were worthless in the eyes of a Calamity Grade Super, in the universe, they were all treasures in the eyes of low-grade Supers.

Looking at this scene, Han Xiao suddenly had a strong sense of déjà vu.

Why does this scene … look so familiar?

Isn't Nero one of those main characters who was groomed by a bunch of old men from a young age?

"Indeed, it's such an Advanced Luck Glow …" Han Xiaoxin found it funny. "To have received so many treasures from a young age, this kid's path is really wide."

Finally, it was Hardaway's turn. Hardaway touched his body and felt that there was nothing he could take out.

Seeing everyone staring at him, he thought for a moment before taking out a deck of Wayne Cards and chuckling.

"Then I will teach you how to play cards."

"Scram!"

Bang!

Han Xiao stood up, raised his leg, and kicked Hadavy to the ground. The nanoparticles turned into shackles and tied Hadavy up tightly.

Nero was shocked and hurriedly retreated. The other Black Star Guards looked left and right, pretending to be enjoying the scenery.

"Wuwuwuwu …" Hardaway's mouth was sealed by alloy, and he could not move at all. Only his eyes were rolling around.

"Lie on the ground and reflect for a while!" Han Xiao was furious.

Teach someone how to play cards, and you will be struck by lightning!

It's fine if you don't use fertilizer, but you want to poison my precious leek?

Do you want my leek to follow in Herlous' footsteps and sink into the abyss of laziness?

Ames supported her chin with her hand and smiled at this scene. Suddenly, she waved her hand and signaled for Nero to come over.

Nero obediently came before Ames and was a little nervous. Although Ames' attitude was very amiable, the feeling she gave him was completely different from the other Black Star Guards. It was as if there was a special noble aura around her. In front of her, Nero subconsciously became reserved.

"Don't be nervous, I have something for you too."

Ames smiled and suddenly took off the obsidian necklace on her neck and placed it in Nero's hand.

Han Xiao was a little surprised. This necklace did not have any special functions, and it was just an ordinary accessory. However, Ames often wore it, so he did not know what was the story behind it.

"Take good care of it."

Ames instructed with a smile. She did not seem to have any intention of explaining herself as she glanced at Han Xiao.

Nero hurriedly nodded and carefully kept the necklace.

After all the 'old grandpas' had given their treasures, Han Xiao pulled Nero in front of him and asked with a smile, "I promised your father that I would nurture you into a powerful Super. You must have learned some Super classes in Blue Star. Do you still remember the different Super classes?"

"En." Nero nodded and counted with his fingers. "There are five: Pugilist, Esper, Mechanic, Magic, and Psychic!"

"Now, it's your turn to make a choice. Which Super do you want to become?" Han Xiao smiled.

He did not know which Super Talent Nero had, so he asked directly.

Everyone fell silent.

Choosing a Super class was a huge matter that would decide one's life. Black Star seemed to be prepared to nurture Nero, so his choice was very important.

Nero hesitated for a moment before raising his head to look at the floating guards flying above his head. His gaze became firm.

"Godfather, I want to be a Mechanic!"

"Haha, good choice!"

Han Xiao was overjoyed. Nero had chosen the Mechanic class, so he could officially become Han Xiao's student. In the Shattered Star Ring, Han Xiao was the peak of the Mechanic class, and no one was more qualified than him to teach others.

Hearing that, many of the Black Star Guards sighed.

Sigh, isn't it good to be a human?

…

Han Xiao activated Nero's Mechanical Force on the spaceship. With his current level, the method of activating Mechanical Force was no longer the electrotherapy that Sylvia had experienced. It was a safer and painless method.

Blue Star was very close to the Black Star Corps headquarters, and Han Xiao and the others returned not long after.

The next day, the Red Empire's transport fleet finally arrived.

The enormous fleet covered the entire sky, and Planet Golden Gate seemed to have welcomed a solar eclipse.

The army headquarters became even more lively.

The first batch of resources supported by the Red Empire was unloaded in the industrial zone and sent to the army's warehouse by the mechanical workers.

The first batch of dynasty elites to be modified also stepped onto the dock of the Black Star Corps headquarters.

There were four captains, and they each brought the elites of their respective factions. Teny was one of the captains, and he represented the dynasty's youth faction.

This group of elites followed the army receptionist all the way to the hall, looking straight ahead.

Walking into the hall, the dynasty elites immediately saw Han Xiao, who had been waiting on the throne for a long time.

"Your Excellency Black Star."

Pa!

The tens of thousands of dynasty elites gave a dynasty military salute at the same time, and their boots stepped on the metal floor, creating a crisp sound.

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and walked down from the throne. This time, the four captains also stepped forward and shook hands with Han Xiao.

The four of them were all famous NPCs in Han Xiao's previous life, and Teny was the most famous of them all. There was basically not a single player in the Red Empire camp who did not know this famous dynasty marshal. This was also the person that Han Xiao paid the most attention to.

Compared to his image in Han Xiao's previous life, the current Teny was still very young, and his aura was like that of a tiger.

When it was Teny's turn to shake hands, Han Xiao stared at his face and suddenly revealed a mysterious smile.

"Teny Amenlos? I've heard a lot about you. "

Teny was stunned.

Black Star did not say anything when he shook hands with the others, so why did he only talk to me?

I've heard a lot about you … Has my name already spread to the Shattered Star Ring?

The intelligence that he had gathered over the past few days appeared in his mind. A few days ago, he had discovered a characteristic of Black Star.

This person has some kind of prediction ability and extremely accurate foresight.

There must be a reason why he only talked to me!

This thought flashed through Teny's mind, but his expression did not change. He clenched his hand before releasing it.
